sloka: अस्त मस्तक संरुद्धो रश्मिः दिनकरात् इव ।पेतुः क्षतज धाराः तु व्रणेभ्यः तस्य सर्वशः ॥४-२३-१९॥
transliteration: asta mastaka saṁruddho raśmiḥ dinakarāt iva ।petuḥ kṣataja dhārāḥ tu vraṇebhyaḥ tasya sarvaśaḥ ॥4-23-19॥

translations.english: The streams of blood that flowed all over from the wounds of his body appeared like streams of water mixed with red and copper colour.
